image.name: mediaelch
image.description: [MediaElch](https://github.com/Komet/MediaElch) is a MediaManager for Kodi. Information about Movies, TV Shows, Concerts and Music are stored as nfo files. Fanarts are downloaded automatically from fanart.tv. Using the nfo generator, MediaElch can be used with other MediaCenters as well.

changelog.desc: Rebase to Debian Trixie, ingest appimage from github.
Make Wayland default disable with PIXELFLUX_WAYLAND=false.
Rebase to noble, ingest latest stable version, install qt deps.
Rebase to Selkies, HTTPS IS NOW REQUIRED.
Update Readme with new env vars and ingest proper PWA icon.

volumes.desc: Users home directory in the container, stores program settings and files.

ports.desc: MediaElch desktop gui HTTP, must be proxied.

image.title: Mediaelch
image.setup_instructions:
The application can be accessed at:

* https://yourhost:3001/

snippets.docker_compose:
---
services:
  mediaelch:
    image: ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mediaelch:latest
    container_name: mediaelch
    environment:
      - PUID=1000
      - PGID=1000
      - TZ=Etc/UTC
    volumes:
      - /path/to/mediaelch/config:/config
    ports:
      - 3000:3000
      - 3001:3001
    shm_size: "1gb"
    restart: unless-stopped
snippets.docker_run:
docker run -d \
  --name=mediaelch \
  -e PUID=1000 \
  -e PGID=1000 \
  -e TZ=Etc/UTC \
  -p 3000:3000 \
  -p 3001:3001 \
  -v /path/to/mediaelch/config:/config \
  --shm-size="1gb" \
  --restart unless-stopped \
  ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mediaelch:latest
